spanish: Tengo un perro.
english: I have a dog
glossary: tengo = I have (from tener) | perro = dog (masc. noun)

spanish: La casa es grande.
english: The house is big
glossary: casa = house (fem. noun) | es = is (from ser) | grande = big

spanish: Mi madre es alta.
english: My mother is tall
glossary: mi = my | madre = mother | alta = tall (fem.; masc. = alto)

spanish: El gato es negro.
english: The cat is black
glossary: gato = cat (masc. noun) | negro = black

spanish: Mi hermano tiene doce años.
english: My brother is twelve years old
glossary: hermano = brother | tiene = has (from tener) | doce = twelve | años = years
notes: Spanish says you "have" years: tener ___ años

spanish: Vivimos en una casa pequeña.
english: We live in a small house
glossary: vivimos = we live (from vivir) | pequeña = small (fem.)

spanish: Mis abuelos son simpáticos.
english: My grandparents are nice
glossary: abuelos = grandparents | son = are (from ser) | simpáticos = nice / friendly

spanish: La cocina está limpia.
english: The kitchen is clean
glossary: cocina = kitchen | está = is (from estar) | limpia = clean (fem.)
notes: Estar for conditions that can change

spanish: Mi hermana mayor estudia en la universidad.
english: My older sister studies at the university
also_accept: My older sister studies at university
glossary: hermana = sister | mayor = older | estudia = studies (from estudiar)

spanish: Hay tres dormitorios en nuestra casa.
english: There are three bedrooms in our house
glossary: hay = there is / there are | dormitorios = bedrooms | nuestra = our (fem.)

spanish: Mi padre cocina la cena los domingos.
english: My father cooks dinner on Sundays
glossary: padre = father | cocina = cooks (from cocinar) | cena = dinner | domingos = Sundays

spanish: Los niños juegan en el jardín.
english: The children play in the garden
glossary: niños = children | juegan = they play (from jugar) | jardín = garden / yard

spanish: Mi tía y mi tío viven cerca de nosotros.
english: My aunt and my uncle live near us
also_accept: My aunt and uncle live near us
glossary: tía = aunt | tío = uncle | viven = they live (from vivir) | cerca de = near | nosotros = us / we

spanish: No me gusta limpiar mi cuarto.
english: I don't like to clean my room
also_accept: I don't like cleaning my room
glossary: me gusta = I like (lit. it pleases me) | limpiar = to clean | cuarto = room

spanish: Mi primo es más alto que yo.
english: My cousin is taller than me
also_accept: My cousin is taller than I
glossary: primo = cousin (masc.) | más alto que = taller than | yo = I / me

spanish: Nuestra sala tiene un sofá azul.
english: Our living room has a blue sofa
also_accept: Our living room has a blue couch
glossary: sala = living room | tiene = has | sofá = sofa / couch | azul = blue

spanish: Cuando era niño, vivía con mis abuelos.
english: When I was a child I lived with my grandparents
also_accept: When I was a kid I lived with my grandparents
glossary: era = I was (imperfect of ser) | niño = child | vivía = I used to live / I lived (imperfect)

spanish: Mi madre quiere que yo lave los platos.
english: My mother wants me to wash the dishes
glossary: quiere que = wants (that) | lave = wash (subjunctive of lavar) | platos = dishes / plates

spanish: Si tuviera más espacio, compraría un perro.
english: If I had more space I would buy a dog
glossary: tuviera = I had (past subjunctive of tener) | espacio = space | compraría = I would buy (conditional)

spanish: Hace dos años que vivimos en esta casa.
english: We have lived in this house for two years
glossary: hace ... que = for (a length of time) | vivimos = we live | esta = this (fem.)
notes: Hace + time + que + present = have been doing for
